source.title: Original Dragonflight processing event logs and item-side Looter cohort deduplication

notes: Fresh name-first source search found no independent unindexed Dragonflight ore prospecting / herb milling cast-by-cast output logs. Serevite/Draconium Reddit quantitative studies are already present; reported per-stack or nominal-ore counts do not establish refunded/reprospected completed casts, output hit counts, or histograms. Investigated high-sample 194347 and 197999 Looter gear tables plus 194386, 194389, 194406 and 207250; all had prior Dragonflight evidence by exact item ID after checking 273 existing Dragonflight JSONL files on the research branch, so none were duplicated as new study cohorts. Looter source snapshot displays may combine item versions and unknown player profiles; per-material occurrence count is not proof of homogeneous current-build P(at least one output per completed cast). Dec 2025 Saxifrage/Blazing Pigment housing forum gives 1k+ pigment stock but no mill attempts or distinct original sample. No new numeric fields or source cohort verified; preserve unknowns, do not infer zeros or measured probabilities. This was deduplication and newly targeted source-search only, not a source-independent measurement.
lookingFor: Original independent completed-operation, refund-reconciled per-material 0/1/2+ histograms for Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite and Prismatic Ore prospecting, Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling, and nonduplicated Dragonflight gear disenchant yield cohorts
